description: Figure 3 is a pie chart illustrating the domain distribution of the annotated AttrEval-GenSearch test set. The chart is divided into a total of 12 slices representing different subject domains. There is no separate legend; instead, the category labels and their corresponding percentages are positioned outside the pie and connected to their respective slices via thin gray lines. Reading clockwise starting from the largest slice at the top right, the categories are: AI/NLP Research in blue (24.3%), Business in red (5.9%), Geography in dark green (2.7%), Math in purple (1.2%), Game&Anime in orange (8.2%), Econ. & Fin. in teal (18.4%), Science in light purple (6.7%), Law in pink (5.1%), History in yellow (8.2%), Med & Health in light green (6.7%), Pet & Animal in a second shade of orange (5.5%), and Daily Life in light blue (7.1%). The chart does not feature any percentage labels inside the slices, nor are any segments visually emphasized through exploding, offsetting, or bolding. Visually, the segments are not arranged in a strict ascending or descending order based on their proportional size.
